body:
## Summary

- add a dedicated `/forum` page that renders Posts-category GitHub Discussions directly in the browser
- use GitHub REST Discussions API with `application/vnd.github.full+json`, no token required
- show `/forum` as a card list; clicking a card opens `/forum?discussion=<number>` as a full-width post view
- cache discussion responses in localStorage for 12 hours without exposing cache status in the UI
- add a simple homepage link to the forum

## Verification

- `npx prettier content/forum.md content/index.md quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx quartz/components/scripts/forum.inline.ts --write`
- `npx quartz build`
- `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false` still reports pre-existing unrelated errors in `EpisodeCarousel.tsx`, `Footer.tsx`, and `GuestSuggestion.tsx`; no forum-related errors
title: Add live GitHub Discussions forum
